title: Machine learning and genetic algorithm-guided directed evolution for the development of antimicrobial peptides.

source_review_depth.supplementary_assets: PMC OA package DOCX mmc1.docx was reopened through OOXML; it contains LBD1-30 background table, algorithm/primer tables, and supplementary figure labels but no supplement-only activity/toxicity value that changes the final layers.

materials_exhausted.supplementary_assets: mmc1.docx parsed with OOXML; embedded figure assets/sequence figure checked where relevant to the blocker; no additional spreadsheet/PDF supplement exists in local packet.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001: the paper is publication-grade with cautions after source-reviewed database row adjudication, final activity cleanup, mechanism replacement, DOCX supplement review, and strict gate rerun. Database-only exact strain identifiers remain preserved as source_conflict cautions rather than being normalized.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All 133 linked DBAASP literature/assay/experiment rows were reopened. Fig. 3b verifies the seven database peptide identities and Table 1 verifies MIC values at peptide/species level; 112 assay/experiment rows remain source_conflict only because DBAASP adds exact CGMCC strain IDs not printed in the primary table.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity is limited to 72 source-supported Table 1 MIC rows for LBDMj, LBDA-D, LBDX, LBDY, and pGFP. The scaffolded entity=MIC duplicates and non-AMP antibiotic comparator cells are excluded from the final AMP layer; no unsupported toxicity value was fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Generic automated mechanism notes were replaced with source-located LBDB claims for CFU killing, SEM/TEM membrane damage, UV LPS interaction, NMR structural context, and shrimp in vivo efficacy. Mechanism limitations are preserved.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review_layer: Prior full-source-review and database-adjudication tickets are resolved with cautions. No blocking or major QC issue remains; material packet/validator readiness remains separate from this publication-grade review decision.

caution_findings.record: 112 linked DBAASP assay/experiment rows with CGMCC strain IDs
caution_findings.note: Primary Table 1 supports MIC values for the named species and source footnotes, but does not print exact CGMCC strain identifiers; these are retained as source_conflict records.
The packet has no linked sequence records, so peptide identity was verified from primary Fig. 3b plus database peptide names rather than a separate database sequence snapshot.
The preliminary activity file contained 40 duplicated rows with entity=MIC and 12 antibiotic comparator rows. The final worker-6 layer keeps source-supported AMP/control peptide rows only.
SEM/TEM and LPS UV evidence support membrane damage and LPS interaction, but the article states further work is needed for exact mode-of-action details; final claims do not overstate that boundary.
The DOCX supplement was recovered from the OA package and parsed. It does not provide a separate activity/toxicity table needed for the final AMP rows.

gate_expectation: Strict semantic and publication-quality gates should pass after this re-review; gate_results are updated after rerun.
